address: 1F, Parklane, 18 Soi Sukhumvit 61, Khlong Tan Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: The logo, fashioned from an N and a W in the shape of a needle flower, stands for Nawa – Thai for innovation. Chefs Joe and Saki Hoshino embrace this concept using modern techniques to produce central Thai cuisine with authentic yet bold flavours, and a seasonal tasting menu of finger food, small bites and modified versions of main courses. The low-lit dining room has a modern and elegant design....
